name: Santa Tracker
author: Jimson Circle of Lights
description: Shows Santa's live position on a Pixel Overlay Model: a world map with Santa, his trail and your town, plus a countdown or an info panel (city, distance, gifts delivered), or a scrolling message. Settings page with live preview. Downloads Santa's route from Google's Santa Tracker (firebasestorage.googleapis.com) and a world coastline outline (raw.githubusercontent.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net or d2ad6b4ur7yvpq.cloudfront.net). Nothing about you or your show is sent anywhere.
